verdict.rationale: Runpod documents MCP servers and an agent skills plugin that let external coding agents drive Runpod in natural language. That is integration with third-party agents, not a built-in AI assistant inside the Runpod product. The evidence never mentions an in-console or in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
